scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run knip && bun run test
scripts.lint:firefox: bun run build:firefox && web-ext lint --self-hosted --source-dir dist-firefox
scripts.sign:firefox: bun run build:firefox && mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && git archive --format zip --output web-ext-artifacts/source.zip HEAD && web-ext sign --source-dir dist-firefox --channel unlisted --upload-source-code web-ext-artifacts/source.zip
scripts.install:safari: bun run build:safari:app && rm -rf ~/Applications/FloHub.app && cp -R safari/build/Build/Products/Release/FloHub.app ~/Applications/ && open ~/Applications/FloHub.app
scripts.build:safari:app: bun run build:safari && xcodebuild -quiet -project safari/FloHub/FloHub.xcodeproj -scheme FloHub -configuration Release -derivedDataPath safari/build MARKETING_VERSION=$(bun -p "require('./dist-safari/manifest.json').version") CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= build
